about: Rekha Jhunjhunwala is the wife of the late investor Rakesh Jhunjhunwala. Since his death in August 2022, the family portfolio has been held by her, their firm Rare Enterprises and family trusts. It is one of the largest disclosed portfolios held by an Indian individual investor family, led by Titan Company.

faq: What is Rekha Jhunjhunwala's portfolio worth?

Holdings in her own name were about ₹44,000–47,000 crore after the September 2026 filings. Including Rare Enterprises and family trusts, the family's disclosed holdings were about ₹60,962 crore across 27 stocks at 22 October 2026 prices.
What did Rekha Jhunjhunwala buy recently?
No new stocks were added in the September 2026 quarter. The only changes were five small trims, in Baazar Style Retail, Canara Bank, VA Tech Wabag, Federal Bank and Tata Motors PV.
Titan Company, a 5.3% stake worth about ₹20,458 crore at 22 October 2026 prices.
How do you know the prices?
Prices are exact only for bulk and block deals, which the exchanges publish daily. Quarterly filings show shares held but not the price paid, so those gains are shown as not public or estimated.
